name: plantmaster-pro
description: PlantMaster Pro — multi-plant maintenance management PWA

scripts.verify: npm run verify:db && npm run verify:fn && npm run verify:push && npm run verify:pwa && npm run verify:links
scripts.functions:deploy: node scripts/confirm-schema.mjs && supabase functions deploy smart-responder condition-analyzer vision-scanner ingest-manual delete-manual voice-translate web-push daily-reports
scripts.deploy: npm run build:app && wrangler pages deploy public --project-name=plantmaster-pro
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build:site && wrangler pages deploy dist/site --project-name=plantmaster-site
scripts.deploy:admin: npm run build:admin && wrangler pages deploy dist/admin --project-name=plantmaster-admin
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy && npm run deploy:site && npm run deploy:admin
